messages:
Maya R: quick note from today's onboarding calls — recurring asks: per-route billing export, faster embedding refresh for live docs, and a "rollback" toggle for model rollouts. logging here for prioritization.
Juan C: saw same with Helio + Brightlane. small teams want exportable invoice breakdowns they can share with finance.
Priya S: agree. can we bucket by impact/effort? my suggestion: per-route export = high impact/low effort; embed refresh = medium impact/medium effort; rollback UI = high effort.
Sam P: i can prototype a minimal CSV export and a canned CS message. reuse our billing-export endpoint, add per-route aggregation. estimate ~1.5 days.
Alex K: telemetry: 38% of new accounts visit "Quotas" page before first successful call. that tracks with "confusing defaults" reports. maybe surface a one-click quota guide during onboarding.
onboard-bot: New onboarding session created: session-2799 by Juan C — https://redwood.internal/onboard/session/2799
Maya R: Priya — can you add a checkbox in the prioritization sheet for "reduces renewal risk"? AMs should mark when the ask materially lowers churn.
Priya S: yup. i'll add: Checkbox + short rationale field. also will add a column for "sample customer quotes" so product sees verbatim context.
Sam P: mock export header i plan to use:
```
customer_id,route_name,total_prompt_tokens,total_completion_tokens,total_tokens,period
helio-123,search,14320,8920,23240,2026-03
```
Sam P: support snippet for CS to send: "Hi — we've added an export so you can pull per-route token usage. Here's how to generate it: Settings > Billing > Export > Select period. Attaching CSV helps finance reconcile usage."
Juan C: can we run the export with 3 pilot customers next week and collect feedback? Helio, Nimbus, and Brightlane volunteered.
Maya R: yes — plan: Sam drops mock by EOD Thursday, Priya updates sheet, Alex drafts the webhook suggestion for embed sync (push vs poll), then we trial with the 3 pilots. short sync Friday 10am to review.
Alex K: will outline webhook flow + fallback polling in the doc.
Priya S: adding renewal-risk checkbox now: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/CS/pages/CS-Feedback-Prioritization
Maya R: please paste any raw customer quotes in that doc — product wants examples not summaries.
Juan C: will paste Helio quote later today.
Sam P: will upload mock and sample CSV to the doc by EOD.
Maya R: thanks team. short check-in Friday 10am. :thumbsup:
